function.name: hypothesize
function.description: Generate new hypotheses about a given topic. Use ONLY when the user requests you to brainstorm, generate novel, new ideas or hypotheses.

user_topic.description: The name of the topic specified by the user.

function.name: elaborate
function.description: Get more context about a given topic. Use ONLY when the user requests you to elaborate upon a topic, add more context or dive deeper into a topic.
